name: outsource
description: Outsource a Maker's substantial projects to an agent-led process from deep interview through verified acceptance.

interface.shortDescription: Outsource substantial work to verified delivery.
interface.longDescription: Delegate substantial work to an agent-led delivery process that qualifies the engagement, interviews the Maker, establishes a delivery contract, selects the simplest reliable execution strategy, verifies results, manages feedback, and learns under explicit governance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $outsource to take this project from deep interview through verified acceptance.
